domain.larger_interval_argument: All routing thresholds/equality keys lie in 1..2428, so every u64 from2429 throughU64_MAX has identical all-false <=/== answers at keys below it; public main rejects pc>2428 before dispatch, unchanged.

comparison_counts.meaning: Pure numeric comparisons in dispatch and group only. No observed PC frequencies; sums are hypothetical one-visit-per-PC, not runtime timing. Early PCs can be slower.
